QuestInfo.name: Pig Herding 2
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1091003##k's got another job for you. Hopefully you can do some REAL piracy this time!
QuestInfo.1: Okay, so you have to herd some more #r#o1210101#s#k. That's fine. Plenty of Pirates got their start fighting festively-decorated pork...
QuestInfo.2: You finished herding the #r#o1210100#s#k and the #r#o1210101#s#k. Now it's time to loot! Plunder! LAND HO!

0.0: I thought the pigs were a perfect match for you. Not that I'm calling you a pig! Har har!
0.1: This time, I want you to teach #r30#k #r#o1210101#s#k a lesson! See, those aren't just any ordinary pigs. They got ribbons, which makes them all kinds of classy! Now, get to it!\r\n

yes.0: Those #r#o1210101#s#k are tougher than normal pigs, so look alive, or you'll be pig food. Complete this mission, though, and I'll give you a special gift.

no.0: You want me to tell the cap'n on you? She'll kick you off the Nautilus, rookie. A sad sight you'd be, a Pirate without a ship!

1.0: Back already? I hope the #r#o1210101#s#k gave you a good workout. Or were they still too easy for you?

yes.0: Well, here's your gift! You like?
yes.1: Remember, you're a Pirate now! We fight hard, and we loot hard! I got one more mission for you, when you're ready.

mob.0: You gonna do the job, or ain't you? Don't bug me again until you've eliminated #r30 #o1210101#s#k!
